steps.message: With the modpack loaded (VRP, Shrooms, RPChatter, PlanBuild, InfinityHammer, Ward is Love, Protective Wards, Arcane Wards): the renamed axe in your inventory keeps its name and description, no errors, and wards from those mods are respected. PlanBuild losing data on stands/walls is known (ISSUE-003). Mark Fail if not tested.
